scope: Server-free Android Local Import for the three signed Registry artifact roles after MOB-05A exact consent and admission
implemented_behavior: Flutter selects an explicit Concepts OBR, labels index or CCIDs index role and receives only bounded progress receipts.
Android owns the ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT URI and streams from the exact signed-manifest source offset without exposing a path, URI or byte buffer to Flutter.
Rust derives the LocalImport/ForegroundNative schedule, request fingerprint, source-plan digest, expected chunk lengths and hashes from the admitted signed release.
Rust revalidates verified rows, resumes an interrupted partial at its durable offset, rejects short or extra source data and reaches BytesComplete only after all three artifact roles verify.
Process loss does not persist provider authority: the user reselects the same source document and Rust resumes from durable verified or partial state.
limitations: The emulator journey uses a public 6 KiB development fixture; it is not the 1.2 GB concepts.obr or full 2.2 GB-class target-filesystem qualification.
Fresh installation still needs an admitted signed trust profile, channel head and release envelope before local artifact import; no central service is required by the byte-import path.
Android process death requires explicit user reselection because transient document-provider authority is deliberately not persisted.
DirectPeer, CommunitySeed, CarrierPeer, optional HTTPS fallback, iOS bounded execution, MOB-05C whole-artifact activation and physical-device energy/recovery gates remain open.
